learn.rule: Signal words show how sentences connect. First, next, then, and finally show order. However shows contrast. For example gives an example.
learn.ruleEs: Las palabras de señal muestran cómo se conectan las oraciones. First, next, then y finally muestran el orden. However muestra contraste. For example da un ejemplo.
learn.model: First, a caterpillar eats leaves. Next, it makes a chrysalis.
learn.notice: First and next tell which step comes earlier and which comes later.

items.prompt: Put the butterfly life cycle sentences in order.
lines: First, a butterfly lays tiny eggs on a leaf.
Next, a caterpillar hatches and eats leaves.
Then, the caterpillar makes a chrysalis.
items.why: The signal words first, next, then and finally show the order of the steps.
items.whyEs: Las palabras de señal first, next, then y finally muestran el orden de los pasos.

items.prompt: Choose the signal word that shows a result for the hungry caterpillar.
items.model: A caterpillar eats a lot. As a result, it grows bigger.
items.why: Growing bigger is the result of eating a lot, so as a result fits.
items.whyEs: Crecer es el resultado de comer mucho, así que as a result encaja.

items.prompt: Which signal word fits? Most butterflies are small. ___, some have wings as wide as a dinner plate.

options.text: However
For example
Finally

items.why: Small and very large are opposites, so however shows the contrast.
items.whyEs: Pequeñas y muy grandes son opuestos, así que however muestra el contraste.

items.prompt: Check every sentence that uses a signal word to show order in planting a seed.

options.text: First, the seed is planted in soil.
Plants need light.
Then, a tiny sprout pushes up.
However, some seeds need warmth.

items.why: First and then show steps in order. However shows a contrast, and the other sentence has no signal word.
items.whyEs: First y then muestran pasos en orden. However muestra un contraste, y la otra oración no tiene palabra de señal.

items.prompt: Choose the signal word that gives an example about nectar.
parts: , a butterfly sips it through a long tongue.
items.model: Many insects drink nectar. For example, a butterfly sips it through a long tongue.
items.why: A butterfly is one example of an insect that drinks nectar, so for example fits.
items.whyEs: La mariposa es un ejemplo de insecto que bebe néctar, así que for example encaja.

items.prompt: Which sentence uses a signal word to add one more fact about butterflies? Butterflies have four wings.

options.text: However, butterflies taste with their feet.
Butterflies taste with their feet.
Also, butterflies taste with their feet.

items.why: Also adds another fact. However would show a contrast, and the middle sentence has no signal word.
items.whyEs: Also agrega otro dato. However mostraría un contraste, y la oración del medio no tiene palabra de señal.

write.prompt: Write three sentences about growing a plant from a seed. Use first, then, and finally.
write.promptEs: Escribe tres oraciones sobre cómo crece una planta desde una semilla. Usa first, then y finally.
write.model: First, plant a seed in soil. Then, water it every day. Finally, watch the sprout grow.

familyTalk.en: Tell the steps for making a sandwich using first, next, then, and finally.
familyTalk.es: Cuenten los pasos para hacer un sándwich usando first, next, then y finally.

teacherTip.en: Cut the order sentences into strips and let pairs arrange them before they check the answer.
teacherTip.es: Corta las oraciones del orden en tiras y deja que las parejas las ordenen antes de revisar la respuesta.

learn.rule: Signal words show how sentences connect. First, next, and finally show order. However shows contrast. As a result shows what happened because of something.
learn.ruleEs: Las palabras de señal muestran cómo se conectan las oraciones. First, next y finally muestran el orden. However muestra contraste. As a result muestra lo que pasó por algo.
learn.model: First, you write a letter. Next, you mail it.
learn.notice: First begins the steps. Next moves to the second step.

items.prompt: Put the mail delivery sentences in order.
lines: First, you write a letter and put it in an envelope.
Next, you add a stamp and mail it.
Then, a mail carrier takes it to a post office.
Finally, another carrier brings it to a friend's house.
items.why: First, next, then and finally tell us where each step belongs.
items.whyEs: First, next, then y finally nos dicen dónde va cada paso.

items.prompt: Choose the signal word that shows a contrast between letters and email.
parts: Letters can take days to arrive.
items.model: Letters can take days to arrive. However, an email arrives in seconds.
items.why: Days and seconds are opposites in speed, so however shows the contrast.
items.whyEs: Días y segundos son opuestos en velocidad, así que however muestra el contraste.

items.prompt: Which signal word fits? Our town has many helpers. ___, firefighters keep us safe.

options.text: However
For example
Finally

items.why: Firefighters are one example of town helpers, so for example fits.
items.whyEs: Los bomberos son un ejemplo de ayudantes del pueblo, así que for example encaja.

items.prompt: Check every sentence that uses a word to show contrast about the post office.

options.text: However, the post office is closed on Sunday.
Next, the mail carrier walks to the door.
The mail truck is red, but the bike is blue.
For example, stamps come in many colors.

items.why: However and but show contrast. Next shows order and for example gives an example.
items.whyEs: However y but muestran contraste. Next muestra orden y for example da un ejemplo.

items.prompt: Choose the signal word that shows what happened when the stores were closed.
parts: , we bought food at the market.
items.model: The stores were closed. As a result, we bought food at the market.
items.why: Buying at the market happened because the stores were closed, so as a result fits.
items.whyEs: Comprar en el mercado ocurrió porque las tiendas estaban cerradas, así que as a result encaja.

items.prompt: Which sentence would end a paragraph about mail helpers?

options.text: First, mail carriers help people stay connected.
For example, mail carriers help people stay connected.
In conclusion, mail carriers help people stay connected.

items.why: In conclusion signals the ending of a paragraph. First begins steps, and for example needs something to give an example of.
items.whyEs: In conclusion señala el final de un párrafo. First empieza pasos, y for example necesita algo de lo cual dar un ejemplo.

write.prompt: Write three sentences about your trip to school. Use first, next, and last.
write.promptEs: Escribe tres oraciones sobre tu camino a la escuela. Usa first, next y last.
write.model: First, I eat breakfast. Next, I walk to the bus stop. Last, I sit with my friends on the bus.

familyTalk.en: Tell each other how you get ready in the morning, using first, next, and last.
familyTalk.es: Cuéntense cómo se preparan por la mañana usando first, next y last.

teacherTip.en: Post the signal words on a chart. Students point to each one as they read their writing aloud.
teacherTip.es: Publica las palabras de señal en un cartel. Los estudiantes señalan cada una al leer su escrito en voz alta.

sets.title: Signal Words in Math Class
sets.titleEs: Palabras de señal en la clase de matemáticas

learn.rule: Signal words show how sentences connect. For example gives an example. Also adds a fact. However shows contrast.
learn.ruleEs: Las palabras de señal muestran cómo se conectan las oraciones. For example da un ejemplo. Also agrega un dato. However muestra contraste.
learn.model: A square has four sides. Also, all of its sides are the same length.
learn.notice: Also tells the reader another fact is coming.

items.prompt: Put the steps for solving a word problem in order.
lines: Next, decide which operation to use.
items.why: First, next, then and finally put the steps in the order you do them.
items.whyEs: First, next, then y finally ponen los pasos en el orden en que los haces.

items.prompt: Choose the signal word that gives an example about adding in any order.
parts: Addition can be done in any order.
, three plus four equals four plus three.
items.model: Addition can be done in any order. For example, three plus four equals four plus three.
items.why: Three plus four equals four plus three shows the idea, so for example fits.
items.whyEs: Tres más cuatro es igual a cuatro más tres muestra la idea, así que for example encaja.

items.prompt: Which signal word fits? Addition puts groups together. ___, subtraction takes some away.

options.text: However
Finally
For example

items.why: Putting together and taking away are opposites, so however shows the contrast.
items.whyEs: Juntar y quitar son opuestos, así que however muestra el contraste.

items.prompt: Check every sentence that shows a result in math class.

options.text: Mia practiced her facts, so she answered quickly.
First, Mia opened her notebook.
As a result, Leo finished the test early.
For example, Leo drew a number line.

items.why: So and as a result show what happened because of something. First shows order and for example gives an example.
items.whyEs: So y as a result muestran lo que pasó por algo. First muestra orden y for example da un ejemplo.

items.prompt: Choose the signal word that shows what came next with the coins.
items.model: We counted the coins. Then, we wrote the total.
items.why: Writing the total came after counting, so then shows the order.
items.whyEs: Escribir el total vino después de contar, así que then muestra el orden.

items.prompt: Which sentence adds one more fact about triangles? A triangle has three sides.

options.text: However, a triangle has three corners.
For example, a triangle has three corners.
Also, a triangle has three corners.

items.why: Also adds a new fact. However shows contrast, and for example would need to give an example of the first fact.
items.whyEs: Also agrega un dato nuevo. However muestra contraste, y for example tendría que dar un ejemplo del primer dato.

write.prompt: Write three or four sentences about your favorite shape. Use for example, also, and however.
write.promptEs: Escribe tres o cuatro oraciones sobre tu figura favorita. Usa for example, also y however.
write.model: A circle is my favorite shape. For example, a wheel is a circle. Also, circles roll easily. However, squares do not roll.

familyTalk.en: Talk about shapes at home. Use also to add a fact and however to show a difference.
familyTalk.es: Hablen de formas en casa. Usen also para agregar un dato y however para mostrar una diferencia.

teacherTip.en: Give each pair three signal word cards and have them build a spoken math paragraph before typing.
teacherTip.es: Da a cada pareja tres tarjetas de palabras de señal y pide que armen un párrafo de matemáticas oral antes de escribir.
